systems.hybrid: BM25 + Dense (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
systems.hybrid_refined: Hybrid (MiniLM) + sub-chunk seek refinement to best transcript segment (w=1, pad=3s)

notes: Primary comparison: hit definition seek, k=3, hybrid_refined vs hybrid. Decision rule: claim improvement iff paired McNemar p < 0.05 on the 30 test queries; otherwise report no detectable difference. bm25 and bge_refined are descriptive comparisons reported regardless of outcome. All candidate systems were shaped by exploration on the 22 dev queries.
